verdict.rationale: Drata publishes an llms.txt at help.drata.com/llms.txt, which serves help-center content such as the Champion's Guide and rollout toolkit, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, probes of the developer portal returned 404 for llms.txt, for markdown doc variants, and for every candidate raw OpenAPI path, so the API reference is not exposed in agent-friendly form. Missing for 10: llms.txt on developers.drata.com, markdown versions of API docs, a fetchable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the llms.txt structure and coverage.
